name: GJH Areca Planter
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials; no third-party assets or textures.
accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not an official GJH product or a fabrication/botanical specification. Dimensions are measured in metres; the floor-centred origin is intended for virtual scene placement.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials created for Blender-3D-Gallery and reused in the owner's Webpage-Design-Gallery GJH V11 concept.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

topology_repair.source_method: Non-destructive native loop-diagonal selection from an additive derived face attribute; zero-face deletion without welding the fluted vessel to preserve pole positions. Original mesh/curve data, 213 parts and 198 leaflets retained.
topology_repair.delivery_method: Original GLB indices reconstructed. Explicit analytic radial-line calibration bounds perpendicular error to 2e-10 m; all 125 positive-area precision residues are on fluted ceramic poles. Original positions/normals/materials/pivots retained.
topology_repair.negative_controls: Real 1 nm and 10 um faces retained by gates; non-opt-in deletion refused.
